about:
I’m Teacher Natalia Bellos, and I believe learning English helps us discover new ways to connect with the world.

In our private lessons, every student learns at their own pace. This blog brings together activities, readings and small milestones along the way.

This is a starter project. Replace this introduction and the illustration with your teacher’s details.

materials.title: A little about me
materials.text:
Hello! My name is Ana. I am learning English, one little step at a time.

Your turn: write three sentences about yourself.
1. My name is…
2. I like…
3. My favourite place is…

Teacher’s tip: read your sentences out loud. Progress does not have to be perfect!

materials.title: Look, describe & imagine
materials.alt: A desk with an open book on the left and a potted green plant on the right. Activity: describe what you can see in five English sentences.

materials.title: A weekend worth sharing
materials.text:
Think about a weekend you enjoyed. Where did you go? Who were you with? What made it special?

Write a short paragraph using the past tense. Try these words: first, then, after that, finally.

Read your paragraph out loud and underline three words you want to practice. We will talk about your story in our next class.
